document: Bilhete de Identidade de Residente (BIR), Macao SAR Resident Identity Card

routes.label: express service: 10 working days, MOP 150 more
special express service: within 3 working days, MOP 250 more

note: The Government Portal's page for a first BIR: MOP 90, plus 150 for the express service or 250 for the special express, summed here; the unemployed and the poor may be exempted (not modelled). The card's term isn't on the page, so it's null; the regulation that sets it is on a host this session can't reach.

sources.title: Macao SAR Government Portal, PS-1065 Application for Macao SAR Resident Identity Card (BIR) – First-Time Application
sources.said: Fees: First-time application: MOP90.00; Express Service: An additional charge of MOP 150.00. Special Express Service: An additional charge of MOP 250.00. ... Normal Service: 15 working days. (Performance Pledge) ... Express Service: 10 working days. (Performance Pledge) ... Special Express Service: Within 3 working days. (Performance Pledge)
